// RecurDyn-compatible RMD file: Simple pendulum
[Units]
  LENGTH = "m"
  FORCE = "N"
  TIME = "s"

[Ground]
  NAME = "ground"
  MASS = 1e6
  GROUND = true

[Body]
  NAME = "pendulum"
  MASS = 1.0
  [Inertia]
    IXX = 0.01  IXY = 0.0  IXZ = 0.0
    IYX = 0.0   IYY = 0.01  IYZ = 0.0
    IZX = 0.0   IZY = 0.0  IZZ = 0.1
  [Position]
    X = 0  Y = 0  Z = -1.0

[Marker]
  NAME = "ground_pin"
  BODY = "ground"
  [Position]
    X = 0  Y = 0  Z = 0

[Marker]
  NAME = "pendulum_pin"
  BODY = "pendulum"
  [Position]
    X = 0  Y = 0  Z = 1.0

[Joint]
  NAME = "pin_joint"
  TYPE = "REVOLUTE"
  I = "ground_pin"
  J = "pendulum_pin"
